question: What was the yearly trend in unit value (price per kg) of the top 3 mineral fuel products (HS4) identified in Luxembourg from 2018 to 2023?

limitations.message: Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity.

sql:
SELECT
  year AS period,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg,
  SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT qty_kg IS NULL) AS value_eur_with_qty
FROM v_lu_trade
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'import'
  AND hs4 IN ('2716', '3606', '4401')
GROUP BY
  year,
  flow
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 10000
title: imports: +61.4 % (2018–2023)
insight: The yearly trend in unit value of the top 3 mineral fuel products imported by Luxembourg increased from 0.09 €/kg in 2018 to 0.14 €/kg in 2023.
This represents a 61.4% rise in unit value over the five-year period.
The highest unit value was recorded in 2022, reaching 0.27 €/kg, before decreasing in 2023.
The unit values in 2023 were still higher than in 2018, showing an overall upward trend.
However, the data only includes trade rows with known quantities, so some volumes and unit values may be missing.
